activity_events_client_trust_valid.name: activity_events_client_trust_valid
activity_events_client_trust_valid.value: client_trust is null or client_trust in ('first-party', 'local', 'commercial', 'consumer')

activity_events_client_id_length.name: activity_events_client_id_length
activity_events_client_id_length.value: client_id is null or char_length(client_id) between 1 and 256

activity_events_external_id_length.name: activity_events_external_id_length
activity_events_external_id_length.value: external_id is null or char_length(external_id) between 1 and 512

api_keys_zone_ids_valid.name: api_keys_zone_ids_valid
api_keys_zone_ids_valid.value:
zone_ids is null or (cardinality(zone_ids) between 1 and 100
        and array_position(zone_ids, null) is null
        and array_to_string(zone_ids, ',') ~ '^(zon_[0-9a-hjkmnp-tv-z]{26})(,zon_[0-9a-hjkmnp-tv-z]{26})*$')

api_keys_expiry.name: api_keys_expiry
api_keys_expiry.value: expires_at > created_at and expires_at <= created_at + interval '366 days'

api_keys_revocation_complete.name: api_keys_revocation_complete
api_keys_revocation_complete.value: (revoked_at is null) = (revoked_by is null) and (revoked_at is null or revoked_at >= created_at)

facet_values_visibility_valid.name: facet_values_visibility_valid
facet_values_visibility_valid.value: visibility is null or visibility in ('hidden', 'discoverable', 'readable')

facet_values_exposure_valid.name: facet_values_exposure_valid
facet_values_exposure_valid.value: exposure is null or exposure in ('metadata-only', 'local-only', 'commercial-only', 'full')

grants_one_target.name: grants_one_target
grants_one_target.value:
(facet is not null and value is not null and object_id is null)
       or (facet is null and value is null and object_id is not null)

grants_expiry_after_creation.name: grants_expiry_after_creation
grants_expiry_after_creation.value: expires_at is null or expires_at > created_at

grants_revoked_after_creation.name: grants_revoked_after_creation
grants_revoked_after_creation.value: revoked_at is null or revoked_at >= created_at

grants_revocation_complete.name: grants_revocation_complete
grants_revocation_complete.value:
(revoked_at is null and revoked_by is null)
       or (revoked_at is not null and revoked_by is not null and revoked_by ~ '^[a-z]+:.+$')

groups_external_id_length.name: groups_external_id_length
groups_external_id_length.value: external_id is null or char_length(external_id) between 1 and 512

oauth_clients_redirects.name: oauth_clients_redirects
oauth_clients_redirects.value: cardinality(redirect_uris) between 1 and 20 and array_position(redirect_uris, null) is null

oauth_clients_trust.name: oauth_clients_trust
oauth_clients_trust.value: (status = 'approved') = (trust is not null) and (trust is null or trust in ('local', 'commercial', 'consumer'))

oauth_clients_decision.name: oauth_clients_decision
oauth_clients_decision.value: (status = 'pending') = (decided_at is null) and (decided_at is null) = (decided_by is null)

oauth_codes_scopes.name: oauth_codes_scopes
oauth_codes_scopes.value: cardinality(scopes) between 1 and 2 and scopes <@ array['files:read', 'files:tag']::text[]

oauth_codes_expiry.name: oauth_codes_expiry
oauth_codes_expiry.value: expires_at > created_at and expires_at <= created_at + interval '10 minutes'

oauth_codes_used.name: oauth_codes_used
oauth_codes_used.value: used_at is null or used_at >= created_at

oauth_grants_scopes.name: oauth_grants_scopes
oauth_grants_scopes.value: cardinality(scopes) between 1 and 2 and scopes <@ array['files:read', 'files:tag']::text[]

oauth_grants_refresh_format.name: oauth_grants_refresh_format
oauth_grants_refresh_format.value: refresh_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and (previous_refresh_hash is null or previous_refresh_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

oauth_grants_expiry.name: oauth_grants_expiry
oauth_grants_expiry.value: expires_at > created_at and expires_at <= created_at + interval '90 days'

oauth_grants_revocation_complete.name: oauth_grants_revocation_complete
oauth_grants_revocation_complete.value: (revoked_at is null) = (revoked_by is null) and (revoked_at is null or revoked_at >= created_at)

oauth_tokens_scopes.name: oauth_tokens_scopes
oauth_tokens_scopes.value: cardinality(scopes) between 1 and 2 and scopes <@ array['files:read', 'files:tag']::text[]

oauth_tokens_expiry.name: oauth_tokens_expiry
oauth_tokens_expiry.value: expires_at > created_at and expires_at <= created_at + interval '1 day'

object_tags_applied_by_matches_source.name: object_tags_applied_by_matches_source
object_tags_applied_by_matches_source.value: applied_by is null or starts_with(applied_by, source || ':')

object_tags_primary_trusted.name: object_tags_primary_trusted
object_tags_primary_trusted.value: primary_by is null or (primary_by ~ '^(user|rule|pack):.+$' and (source <> 'model' or reviewed))

object_tags_model_provenance.name: object_tags_model_provenance
object_tags_model_provenance.value:
(model_confidence is null and model_applied_by is null)
       or (source in ('rule', 'pack') and model_confidence >= 0 and model_confidence <= 1
           and (model_applied_by is null or model_applied_by ~ '^model:.+$'))

objects_display_title_length.name: objects_display_title_length
objects_display_title_length.value: display_title is null or char_length(display_title) between 1 and 1024

objects_display_title_has_author.name: objects_display_title_has_author
objects_display_title_has_author.value: display_title is null or display_title_by is not null

scim_tokens_expiry.name: scim_tokens_expiry
scim_tokens_expiry.value: expires_at > created_at and expires_at <= created_at + interval '366 days'

scim_tokens_last_used.name: scim_tokens_last_used
scim_tokens_last_used.value: last_used_at is null or last_used_at >= created_at

scim_tokens_revocation_complete.name: scim_tokens_revocation_complete
scim_tokens_revocation_complete.value: (revoked_at is null) = (revoked_by is null) and (revoked_at is null or revoked_at >= created_at)

sessions_expiry.name: sessions_expiry
sessions_expiry.value: expires_at > created_at and expires_at <= created_at + interval '30 days'

sessions_revocation_complete.name: sessions_revocation_complete
sessions_revocation_complete.value: (revoked_at is null) = (revoked_by is null) and (revoked_at is null or revoked_at >= created_at)

source_syncs_token_length.name: source_syncs_token_length
source_syncs_token_length.value: token is null or char_length(token) between 1 and 65536

source_syncs_delta_cursor.name: source_syncs_delta_cursor
source_syncs_delta_cursor.value: phase = 'crawl' or token is not null

source_syncs_identity_length.name: source_syncs_identity_length
source_syncs_identity_length.value: source_identity is null or char_length(source_identity) between 1 and 1024

source_syncs_reconcile_counts.name: source_syncs_reconcile_counts
source_syncs_reconcile_counts.value: (reconcile_held is null or reconcile_held >= 0) and (reconcile_confirmed is null or reconcile_confirmed >= 0)

tag_reviews_applied_by_matches_source.name: tag_reviews_applied_by_matches_source
tag_reviews_applied_by_matches_source.value: applied_by is null or starts_with(applied_by, source || ':')

tag_reviews_resolution_complete.name: tag_reviews_resolution_complete
tag_reviews_resolution_complete.value:
(decision is null and resolved_by is null and resolved_at is null and merged_into is null)
       or (decision is not null and decision in ('approved', 'rejected', 'merged', 'withdrawn')
           and resolved_by is not null and resolved_by ~ '^[a-z]+:.+$'
           and resolved_at is not null and resolved_at >= created_at
           and (decision = 'merged') = (merged_into is not null))

users_external_id_unique.name: users_external_id_unique
users_external_id_unique.where: external_id is not null and retired_at is null

users_user_name_unique.name: users_user_name_unique
users_user_name_unique.where: user_name_key is not null and retired_at is null

users_service_email.name: users_service_email
users_service_email.value: (kind = 'service') = (email is null) and (email is null) = (email_key is null)

users_external_id_length.name: users_external_id_length
users_external_id_length.value: external_id is null or char_length(external_id) between 1 and 512

users_user_name_complete.name: users_user_name_complete
users_user_name_complete.value:
(user_name is null) = (user_name_key is null)
       and (user_name is null or char_length(user_name) between 1 and 512)
       and (user_name_key is null or char_length(user_name_key) between 1 and 512)

users_name_parts_length.name: users_name_parts_length
users_name_parts_length.value:
(given_name is null or char_length(given_name) between 1 and 256)
       and (family_name is null or char_length(family_name) between 1 and 256)

users_provider_disabled_by_scim.name: users_provider_disabled_by_scim
users_provider_disabled_by_scim.value: provider_disabled_by is null or (provider_disabled_by ~ '^scim:.+$' and source = 'scim')

users_admin_current.name: users_admin_current
users_admin_current.value: admin_at is null or retired_at is null

version_extracts_failure_when_failed.name: version_extracts_failure_when_failed
version_extracts_failure_when_failed.value: (status = 'failed') = (failure is not null) and (failure is null or failure ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$')

versions_pending_idx.name: versions_pending_idx
versions_pending_idx.where: processed_at is null and superseded_at is null

versions_processed_after_creation.name: versions_processed_after_creation
versions_processed_after_creation.value: processed_at is null or processed_at >= created_at

versions_superseded_unprocessed.name: versions_superseded_unprocessed
versions_superseded_unprocessed.value: superseded_at is null or (processed_at is null and superseded_at >= created_at)
